high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "millionerinvestor," located in Oslo, Norway. The post features a stunning photograph of a coastal village with red cabins perched on rocky terrain, surrounded by snow-capped mountains under a night sky illuminated by the Northern Lights (aurora borealis). The setting evokes a serene and picturesque atmosphere, typical of the Arctic region. The text overlay on the image reads: "World's No. 1 wealth fund makes $110 billion as stocks soar.
